options.description: Store batch. Test after storm when proper analysis possible.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Batch stored. Decision deferred. Risk transferred.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Storage may affect quality. Uncertainty continues.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If clean, saved. If contaminated, delayed the inevitable.

crisis.title: Worker Shelter Space
crisis.setup: Keystone shelter is at capacity. A group of Sterling residents (non-Meridian employees) arrives seeking shelter. Turning them away sends them back into the storm.

options.label: Employees only
options.description: Shelter is for Meridian employees. Others must leave.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Non-employees turned away. Some may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling residents remember. Community divided forever.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Deaths blamed on corporate policy. Legal exposure.

options.label: Accept everyone
options.description: Accept all who need shelter. Overcrowd if necessary.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Shelter overcrowded. Resources strained. All alive.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Conditions deteriorate. But everyone together.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community bonds formed. Resources depleted.

options.label: Women and children only
options.description: Accept women and children. Others must find alternatives.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Families sheltered. Men turned away.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Men face storm alone. Some resentment.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Traditional priority honored. Some deaths among men.

crisis.title: Port Rescue Priority
crisis.setup: Storm surge trapped people at the port. One boat can make one rescue run. Choice: trapped workers at the processing plant (12 people) or tourists stranded at a collapsed pier (6 people including children).

options.label: Rescue workers first
options.description: 12 workers at processing plant.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 12 workers rescued. Tourists wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If boat cannot return, tourists die.
consequenceSketch.delayed: More lives saved by numbers. But children...

options.label: Rescue tourists first
options.description: 6 tourists including children.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 6 tourists rescued including children. Workers wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers feel abandoned. May not survive wait.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Children saved. Workers may die.

options.label: Take who fits
options.description: Take as many as boat holds regardless of group.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Mixed rescue. Some workers, some tourists.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither group fully rescued. Both wait.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Partial success. Some from each group survive.

crisis.title: Flooded Warehouse
crisis.setup: Cold chain warehouse is flooding. Workers can attempt to save $5M in pharmaceutical supplies, but water is rising and conditions are dangerous. Or they can evacuate now and lose everything.

options.label: Attempt rescue
options.description: Workers enter flooding warehouse to save supplies.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers enter dangerous conditions. Some supplies saved.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If workers are injured, Santos will never forgive.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Some supplies saved. Possible injuries or deaths.

options.label: Evacuate immediately
options.description: Abandon supplies. Get workers to safety.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers evacuate. Supplies lost.
consequenceSketch.ripple: $5M loss. But all workers safe.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right call for safety. Financial loss blamed on storm.

options.label: Volunteers only
options.description: Anyone who wants to can try. No pressure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some volunteer. Others leave. Division.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Those who stayed may be heroes or victims.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Individual choice. Collective outcome.

crisis.title: Union Defiance
crisis.setup: Webb orders Haven workers to help secure Keystone facilities. Santos says no—her workers have done enough and face their own risks. Defying corporate order could cost jobs later.

options.label: Defy order
options.description: Refuse Webb order. Workers stay in Haven.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers stay. Webb notes defiance.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Keystone facilities may suffer without help.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Union solidarity demonstrated. Retaliation likely.

options.label: Follow order
options.description: Send workers to Keystone as ordered.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers sent to Keystone. Haven less protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers resentful. Santos loses credibility.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Corporate relationship maintained. Worker trust damaged.

options.label: Negotiate conditions
options.description: Send some workers with safety guarantees.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Partial compliance with conditions.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither side fully satisfied.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Compromise. Relationship preserved but strained.

crisis.title: Last Helicopter Seats
crisis.setup: Last helicopter out before conditions become impossible. 4 seats. Candidates: pregnant woman, elderly executive, injured child, Tanaka (needed for dam operations), essential medical technician.

options.label: Most vulnerable
options.description: Pregnant woman, child, elderly executive, random fourth.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Vulnerable evacuated. Tanaka and technician remain.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Dam may be at risk without Tanaka. Medical capacity reduced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Traditional priority honored. Essential personnel at risk.

options.label: Essential personnel
options.description: Tanaka, medical technician, pregnant woman, child.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Essential personnel evacuated. Elderly executive remains.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Executive furious. Board will hear about this.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Operations preserved. Political consequences.

options.label: Fair lottery
options.description: Random selection among all candidates.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Random selection. Chance determines who lives.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Perceived as fair but possibly unwise.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No one can be blamed for selection bias.

crisis.title: Stranded Crew
crisis.setup: A harvest vessel crew is stranded offshore—the ship that made the final run. They can attempt to reach shore in dangerous seas, or shelter on the vessel and wait for conditions to improve.

options.label: Attempt to reach shore
options.description: Order crew to attempt shore approach in dangerous seas.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew attempts approach. High risk of capsizing.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If they make it, rescued. If not, lost at sea.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heroic or tragic. No middle ground.

options.label: Shelter on vessel
options.description: Order crew to ride out storm on the vessel.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew shelters on vessel. Conditions worsen.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Vessel may survive or may sink. Unknown.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Waiting game. Outcome uncertain.

options.label: Let crew decide
options.description: Give captain authority to choose.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Captain makes call. Crew accepts decision.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Outcome same but responsibility different.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Captain bears weight of decision, good or bad.

crisis.title: Fuel Depot Fire Risk
crisis.setup: Lightning strike near fuel depot. Fire risk increasing. Can attempt emergency drainage (risky, requires personnel in danger zone) or evacuate area and let it burn if ignited.

options.label: Attempt drainage
options.description: Send crew to drain fuel depot before ignition.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew enters danger zone. Racing against ignition.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If successful, depot saved. If not, workers may die.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Hero or martyr. High stakes gamble.

options.label: Evacuate and let burn
options.description: Pull everyone back. If it ignites, let it burn.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Everyone safe. Depot at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If it burns, environmental damage, fuel loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No lives risked. Property may be lost.

options.label: Quick partial drain
options.description: Brief attempt to drain critical tanks only.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Limited exposure. Partial protection.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some fuel saved if successful.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Moderate risk, moderate reward.

crisis.title: Dam Stress Alert
crisis.setup: Sensors show dam stress increasing. Tanaka says 60% chance structure is fine, 40% chance of failure. He can do controlled release (floods Haven downstream) or hope it holds.

options.label: Controlled release
options.description: Release water now to reduce stress. Haven will flood.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Water released. Haven floods. People may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Haven devastated. But dam survives.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Controlled disaster vs. uncontrolled catastrophe.

options.label: Hold and hope
options.description: Maintain current state. Hope structure holds.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Status quo. 40% chance of catastrophic failure.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If it fails, uncontrolled flood kills more.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Either fine or disaster. Binary outcome.

options.label: Partial release
options.description: Small release to reduce stress but minimize downstream damage.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Moderate release. Some downstream flooding.
consequenceSketch.ripple: May not be enough to protect dam. May still hurt Haven.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that may satisfy neither objective.

crisis.title: Hospital Power Priority
crisis.setup: Power grid failing. Tanaka can maintain power to either Sterling hospital (life support) OR Keystone clean rooms (production). Not both.

options.label: Hospital priority
options.description: Maintain power to Sterling hospital.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital maintains life support. Clean rooms fail.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Lives saved. Months of production lost.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right thing done. Corporate furious.

options.label: Keystone priority
options.description: Maintain power to Keystone clean rooms.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Clean rooms protected. Hospital loses life support.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Patients die. Production preserved.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Indefensible decision. Criminal liability possible.

options.label: Alternating power
options.description: Alternate power between both every hour.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Neither fully served. Both partially maintained.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Hospital patients at risk during gaps. Clean rooms unstable.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Compromise that serves neither well.

crisis.title: Controlled Release
crisis.setup: Reservoir at 110% capacity. Must release water somewhere. Options: flood the access road (isolates Heartland), flood agricultural area (destroys crops), or flood industrial drainage (environmental contamination).

options.label: Flood access road
options.description: Release into access road. Heartland isolated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Road floods. Heartland cut off for days.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka and crew stranded. Cannot help other parishes.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Isolation may be dangerous if emergencies arise.

options.label: Flood agriculture
options.description: Release into agricultural area. Crops destroyed.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crops destroyed. Food supply impacted.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Farmers devastated. Long-term food security affected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Agricultural recovery takes seasons.

options.label: Industrial drainage
options.description: Release into industrial drainage. Environmental contamination.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Environmental contamination downstream.
consequenceSketch.ripple: EPA investigation. Cleanup costs enormous.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Long-term environmental damage. Legal liability.

crisis.title: Bunker Access
crisis.setup: Executive bunker has capacity for 200. 500 Summit residents seeking shelter. Webb can restrict to executives and families, open to all (overcrowded), or lottery.

options.label: Executives only
options.description: Bunker restricted to executives and immediate families.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 200 executives sheltered. 300 turned away.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Scientists, staff, families seek shelter elsewhere.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Survivors remember who was protected.

options.label: Open to all
options.description: Accept everyone. Severely overcrowded.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 500 people in space for 200. Dangerous conditions.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Executives uncomfortable. But everyone together.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Overcrowding may cause injuries. But solidarity demonstrated.

options.label: Fair lottery
options.description: Random selection for 200 spots.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Random selection. Executives may lose spots.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Perceived as fair. Outcome unpredictable.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No favoritism. But random chance determines survival.

crisis.title: Public Statement
crisis.setup: Communications briefly restored. Webb can broadcast public statement. Options: honest assessment (terrifying but true), reassuring message (calming but misleading), or operational update only (informative but cold).

options.label: Honest assessment
options.description: Full truth: situation dire, casualties expected.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Public terrified. Panic in shelters.
consequenceSketch.ripple: People know truth. Prepare for worst.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If honest, trusted. If wrong, blamed for panic.

options.label: Reassuring message
options.description: Calm message: situation under control, stay strong.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Public calmed. Some false hope.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If reality worse, trust destroyed.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Short-term calm. Long-term credibility risk.

options.label: Operational only
options.description: Facts only: conditions, shelter locations, no editorializing.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Useful information. No emotional content.
consequenceSketch.ripple: People informed but not comforted.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Professional but cold. Defensible.

crisis.title: Resource Commandeering
crisis.setup: Webb can invoke emergency authority to commandeer private resources (vehicles, generators, supplies) from Sterling residents for corporate use. Legal but ethically questionable.

options.label: Commandeer resources
options.description: Use emergency authority to take what is needed.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources redistributed. Private property taken.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling residents furious. Mayor Chen protests.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Resources available but trust destroyed.

options.label: Request voluntarily
options.description: Ask for donations. Accept only what is freely given.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some donations. Many keep their resources.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Respect maintained. Resources limited.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Goodwill preserved. May not have enough.

options.label: Commandeer with compensation
options.description: Take what is needed with promise of full compensation.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources taken with payment promise.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Mixed reception. Some accept, some resist.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Depends on whether promises are kept.

crisis.title: Shelter Overflow
crisis.setup: Sterling shelter at 150% capacity. More people arriving. Chen can turn away new arrivals (send into storm), pack tighter (dangerous conditions), or redirect to hospital (strain medical).

options.label: Turn away new arrivals
options.description: Shelter full. No more can be accepted.

consequenceSketch.immediate: New arrivals turned away. Some may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Those turned away seek other shelter or face storm.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Those inside safe. Those outside at risk.

options.label: Accept everyone
options.description: Accept all arrivals. Dangerous overcrowding.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Everyone accepted. Standing room only.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Disease risk. Panic risk. Crush injuries possible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: All sheltered. Conditions dangerous for all.

options.label: Redirect to hospital
options.description: Send overflow to hospital which has some capacity.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Overflow sent to hospital. Medical capacity strained.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Hospital treating healthy people. Actual patients affected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Shelter maintained. Hospital overwhelmed.

crisis.title: Medical Triage
crisis.setup: Hospital overwhelmed. Doctors ask Chen to authorize crisis triage standards: treat those most likely to survive, let others pass. Normal standard: treat everyone.

options.label: Authorize crisis triage
options.description: Allow doctors to prioritize survivable cases.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Doctors triage. Some patients not treated.
consequenceSketch.ripple: More lives saved overall. But some abandoned.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Utilitarian outcome. Families question choices.

options.label: Maintain normal standard
options.description: Treat all patients equally as resources allow.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All treated equally. Resources spread thin.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Fewer overall saved. But no one abandoned.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Equal treatment. More total deaths.

options.label: Doctor discretion
options.description: Let individual doctors make their own decisions.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Inconsistent treatment across cases.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some doctors triage, some do not.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No policy to defend or criticize.

crisis.title: Looting Response
crisis.setup: Looting reported at abandoned stores. Some looting survival supplies (food, water), some taking electronics. Chen can authorize force, look away, or differentiate response.

options.label: Strict enforcement
options.description: Authorize force against all looting. Law is law.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Looting suppressed. Some injuries.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Order maintained. But desperate people punished.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Law upheld. Community resentment.

options.label: Look away
options.description: Ignore looting. Focus resources on life safety.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Looting continues unchecked.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some take survival needs. Some take advantage.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Chaos. But resources focused on saving lives.

options.label: Differentiate response
options.description: Allow survival supply taking. Stop electronics theft.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Nuanced enforcement. Judgment calls required.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some see as fair. Some see as inconsistent.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that requires explanation.

crisis.title: Inter-Parish Rescue
crisis.setup: Brief window for rescue operations. One rescue team available. Multiple parishes reporting emergencies. Who gets help first?

options.label: Sterling first
options.description: Highest population, most non-Meridian residents.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Sterling receives first response.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Other parishes wait. Corporate facilities second.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community priority demonstrated.

options.label: Keystone first
options.description: Protect critical production facility.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Keystone receives first response.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Other parishes note corporate priority.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Production protected. Community resentment.

options.label: Nearest first
options.description: Help closest emergency first for efficiency.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Nearest emergency addressed first.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Efficient but possibly unfair.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Defensible as practical. May not serve greatest need.

crisis.title: Information Blackout
crisis.setup: Communications mostly down. Webb has satellite phone. He can share it for public emergency calls, keep it for corporate coordination, or give it to Mayor Chen for government use.

options.label: Public emergency calls
options.description: Allow anyone with emergencies to use satellite phone.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Phone overwhelmed with calls. Battery drain.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some emergencies reported. Corporate comms limited.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Public served. Corporate coordination suffers.

options.label: Corporate coordination
options.description: Reserve phone for corporate emergency coordination.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Corporate maintains communication capability.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Public without external contact. Isolation complete.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Operations maintained. Public trust damaged.

options.label: Give to government
options.description: Give phone to Mayor Chen for government emergency use.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Government has communication. Corporate does not.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Chen controls information flow.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Government empowered. Corporate dependent.

recovery.title: Production Restart Timing
recovery.setup: Storm passed. Clean rooms need assessment before restart. Webb wants production ASAP. Reeves says proper safety checks take 72 hours. Rushing risks contamination.

options.label: Rush restart
options.description: Begin production in 24 hours with abbreviated checks.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production restarts quickly. Contamination risk elevated.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers worried about conditions. Quality uncertain.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If contamination, worse than delay. If clean, saved time.

options.label: Full 72-hour protocol
options.description: Complete safety assessment before restart.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production delayed. Webb furious.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers appreciate safety priority. Board questions delay.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Safe restart. Financial loss from delay.

options.label: Parallel assessment
options.description: Begin production in safe areas while assessing others.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Partial production. Ongoing assessment.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some output maintained. Some risk accepted.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground. Neither fully safe nor fully productive.

recovery.title: Worker Compensation
recovery.setup: Workers lost wages during storm shutdown. Santos demands full pay for missed shifts plus hazard bonus. Corporate offers 50% with no bonus, citing losses.

options.label: Full compensation plus bonus
options.description: Meet all union demands.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers paid in full. Significant corporate expense.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Worker morale high. Board questions expense.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Long-term loyalty earned. Short-term financial pain.

options.label: 50% no bonus
options.description: Accept corporate offer.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers angry. Some quit.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Union files grievance. Talent loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Corporate saves money. Worker trust destroyed.

options.label: Negotiate 75%
options.description: Counter-offer at 75% with small bonus.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Negotiation continues. Moderate agreement possible.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither side fully satisfied.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Relationship preserved but strained.

recovery.title: Tourism vs Residents
recovery.setup: Airport reopening. Limited capacity. Tourism board wants to resume flights to save industry. Residents who evacuated want to return home first.

options.label: Residents return first
options.description: Priority to returning residents over tourists.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Residents return. Tourism delayed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tourism industry suffers extended loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community restored. Economic recovery slower.

options.label: Tourism priority
options.description: Resume tourism to boost economic recovery.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tourists arrive. Residents wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Economic activity resumes. Community anger.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Money flowing. Residents displaced longer.

options.label: Balanced schedule
options.description: Split flights between resident return and tourism.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Both served partially.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither fully satisfied. Compromise visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Moderate progress on both fronts.

recovery.title: Infrastructure Blame
recovery.setup: Dam held but barely. Investigation asks: was it maintenance deferral or act of God? Tanaka knows maintenance was deferred due to budget cuts Webb approved. Truth protects Tanaka but exposes corporate.

options.label: Tell full truth
options.description: Testify about deferred maintenance and budget cuts.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Truth told. Webb exposed. Corporate liability.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka protected but may be blacklisted from industry.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right thing done. Career consequences.

options.label: Blame storm
options.description: Testify that storm exceeded all design parameters.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Storm blamed. Corporate protected. Tanaka protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Deferred maintenance continues. Next storm may be worse.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Lie maintained. Problem unfixed.

options.label: Partial disclosure
options.description: Mention concerns were raised without specific blame.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Concerns noted. No smoking gun.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Investigation may dig deeper or may accept.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth partially told. Outcomes uncertain.

recovery.title: Board Report
recovery.setup: Board demands report on storm response. Webb can present honest assessment (admits failures), spin positive (minimizes problems), or blame-shift (identifies scapegoats).

options.label: Honest assessment
options.description: Present full truth including corporate failures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Board sees failures. Webb at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some board members respect honesty. Others want blood.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Trust built with honest board members. Position at risk.

options.label: Spin positive
options.description: Emphasize successes, minimize failures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Board somewhat satisfied. Reality hidden.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If truth emerges later, worse consequences.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Short-term survival. Long-term exposure risk.

options.label: Identify scapegoats
options.description: Blame failures on specific individuals (Reeves, Tanaka).

consequenceSketch.immediate: Scapegoats identified. Webb protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Good people sacrificed. Others take note.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Loyalty destroyed. Future cooperation unlikely.

recovery.title: Scapegoat Selection
recovery.setup: Board wants someone fired. Webb can sacrifice Reeves (production decisions), Tanaka (infrastructure), or take responsibility himself and resign.

options.label: Fire Reeves
options.description: Blame production decisions. Reeves terminated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Reeves fired. Board satisfied.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Reeves was trying to protect workers. Injustice visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Wrong person blamed. System unchanged.

options.label: Fire Tanaka
options.description: Blame infrastructure maintenance. Tanaka terminated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tanaka fired. Board satisfied.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka warned about problems. Injustice visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Wrong person blamed. Dam expertise lost.

options.label: Webb resigns
options.description: Take responsibility. Offer resignation.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Webb resigns. Board may accept or decline.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Leadership change. Uncertainty.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Accountability demonstrated. Future uncertain.

recovery.title: Memorial Politics
recovery.setup: Community wants memorial for storm victims. Options: corporate-funded (controlled message), community-funded (authentic but modest), or joint memorial with shared naming rights.

options.label: Corporate-funded memorial
options.description: Accept Meridian funding for grand memorial.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Large memorial funded. Meridian branding prominent.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Families feel memorial is corporate PR.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Nice memorial. Complicated legacy.

options.label: Community-funded memorial
options.description: Modest memorial funded by community donations.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Smaller memorial. Community ownership.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Authentic tribute. Modest scale.
consequenceSketch.delayed: True community healing. Modest monument.

options.label: Joint memorial
options.description: Combined funding with shared governance.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Negotiations over naming, design, message.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Compromise memorial. Mixed ownership.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Balance achieved. Neither fully satisfied.

recovery.title: Rebuilding Priorities
recovery.setup: Limited rebuilding resources. Chen must choose priority: hospital expansion (serving all), affordable housing (residents displaced), or business district (economic recovery).

options.label: Hospital expansion
options.description: Prioritize medical capacity improvement.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital expansion begins. Housing waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Medical capacity improved. Displaced still displaced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Better prepared for next crisis. Current crisis unresolved.

options.label: Affordable housing
options.description: Prioritize housing for displaced residents.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Housing construction begins. Economic recovery waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Residents return home. Business district struggles.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community restored. Economic recovery slower.

options.label: Business district
options.description: Prioritize economic recovery infrastructure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Business district rebuilt. Housing waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Jobs return. Displaced remain displaced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Economic engine restored. Community still fractured.

recovery.title: Public Narrative
recovery.setup: Media wants the story. Options: unified corporate/government message (controlled but may feel hollow), independent accounts (authentic but may be contradictory), or full transparency (all documents released).

options.label: Unified message
options.description: Corporate and government agree on single narrative.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Coordinated message. Consistent story.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some truth hidden. Official line maintained.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Unity preserved. Trust depends on story holding.

options.label: Independent accounts
options.description: Everyone tells their own story.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Multiple stories. Contradictions visible.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Authentic but messy. Blame-shifting possible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth emerges eventually. Unified front gone.

options.label: Full transparency
options.description: Release all documents. Let public judge.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All documents public. Nothing hidden.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Full picture visible. Judgments follow.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth known. Consequences follow.

recovery.title: Lessons Learned
recovery.setup: Final reflection session. What changes should be made? Options range from minor process tweaks to fundamental restructuring of corporate-community relationship.

options.label: Process improvements
options.description: Minor adjustments to emergency procedures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Small changes implemented. Core unchanged.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Easy to implement. May not prevent next crisis.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Comfortable change. Real issues remain.

options.label: Structural reforms
options.description: Significant changes to corporate governance and community input.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Major changes proposed. Implementation difficult.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Real change possible. Resistance expected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If implemented, better outcomes. If not, frustration.

options.label: Independent oversight
options.description: Create independent body to monitor corporate-community relations.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Oversight body proposed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Accountability mechanism created. Corporate resistance.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Depends on oversight body independence and power.
